recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U Never Trail In Victory Over Eastlake
October 25, 2026 vs. Eastlake
Newport Select Gold 14U were in control the entire time on Sunday versus Eastlake. Newport Select Gold 14U never trailed in their 54-30 victory at Tahoma High School.
Kalden Sen scored 13 points to lead Newport Select Gold 14U.
Newport Select Gold 14U had a strong first half, leading 25-13 at halftime and never looked back, securing the victory. Leading 35-24, Newport Select Gold 14U went on an 11-point run to pull further away.
Newport Select Gold 14U had four assists in the fourth quarter, as they outscored Eastlake 19-6.
Aiden Ng hit two threes for Newport Select Gold 14U. Newport Select Gold 14U passed the ball well with 10 assists on 22 made baskets. Newport Select Gold 14U swiped 15 steals in the game. Talen Tep led the team with five steals. Sen led Newport Select Gold 14U with nine rebounds. Ng (11 points), Aiden Shih (10 points), Charles (8 points), Harry Zhang (4 points), Tep (2 points), Uttam Verriach (2 points), Deacon Chun (2 points), and Mason Huang (2 points) helped out Newport Select Gold 14U as well.
Eastlake shot well from distance, going 4-11 from three.
